root.command: IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.GpsSettingsTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.GpsSettingsTbl', N'AzureMapsKey') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.GpsSettingsTbl ADD AzureMapsKey NVARCHAR(500) NULL; END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CustomerLocationTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.CustomerLocationTbl', N'ExpiresDate') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.CustomerLocationTbl ADD ExpiresDate DATETIME NULL; END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CustomerLocationTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.CustomerLocationTbl', N'DriverFixes') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.CustomerLocationTbl ADD DriverFixes INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_CustomerLocation_DriverFixes DEFAULT (0); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CustomerLocationTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.CustomerLocationTbl', N'LastDriverFixAt') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.CustomerLocationTbl ADD LastDriverFixAt DATETIME NULL; END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.MobileDeliveryProofTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.MobileDeliveryProofTbl', N'AccuracyM') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.MobileDeliveryProofTbl ADD AccuracyM DECIMAL(8,1) NULL; END
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.GpsSettingsTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.GpsSettingsTbl', N'MapProvider') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.GpsSettingsTbl ADD MapProvider VARCHAR(20) NULL; END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.DeliveryVisitTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.DeliveryVisitTbl ( VisitDate DATE NOT NULL, PersonID INT NOT NULL, ContactID INT NOT NULL, FirstAt DATETIME NOT NULL, LastAt DATETIME NOT NULL, Position INT NULL, Stops INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_DeliveryVisit_Stops DEFAULT (0), CONSTRAINT PK_DeliveryVisitTbl PRIMARY KEY (VisitDate, PersonID, ContactID) ); CREATE INDEX IX_DeliveryVisit_Contact ON dbo.DeliveryVisitTbl (ContactID, VisitDate DESC) INCLUDE (PersonID, Position, Stops); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.DeliveryRouteTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.DeliveryRouteTbl ( RouteDate DATE NOT NULL, PersonID INT NOT NULL, ContactID INT NOT NULL, Seq INT NOT NULL, SetAt DATETIME NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_DeliveryRoute_SetAt DEFAULT (GETDATE()), SetBy NVARCHAR(100) NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_DeliveryRouteTbl PRIMARY KEY (RouteDate, PersonID, ContactID) ); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.MobileApiSettingsTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.MobileApiSettingsTbl', N'LandlinePrefixes') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.MobileApiSettingsTbl ADD LandlinePrefixes NVARCHAR(200) NULL; END
